description: This file defines the ShippingService interface which specifies various methods for managing shipping configurations, retrieving shipping options, packages details, and quotes within an e-commerce system.

methods.name: getSupportedCountries
methods.description: Returns a list of country codes that the merchant supports for shipping, based on the merchant's configuration.

methods.name: setSupportedCountries
methods.description: Sets or updates the list of supported country codes for shipping for a specific merchant.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping modules for the merchant.

methods.name: getShippingModulesConfigured
methods.description: Provides a map of shipping modules that are configured for the merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Saves a shipping quote module configuration for the merchant.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves shipping configuration settings for the merchant.

methods.name: saveShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the overall shipping configuration settings for the merchant.

methods.name: removeShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a specific shipping module configuration from the merchant.

methods.name: getPackagesDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information about packaging for shipping calculation based on products.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Generates shipping quotes based on store, delivery, products, and language.

methods.name: getShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific shipping module configuration by module code.

methods.name: getCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves custom shipping configuration for a specific module.

methods.name: saveCustomShippingConfiguration
methods.description: Saves custom shipping configuration for a module.

methods.name: removeCustomShippingQuoteModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a custom shipping quote module configuration.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary based on the selected shipping quote and option, used for order calculations.

methods.name: getShipToCountryList
methods.description: Returns a list of countries to which shipping is available, based on merchant configuration.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if shipping is required based on cart items and merchant settings.
